verdict.rationale: Morph publishes concrete speed figures in its docs: Fast Apply at 10,500 tok/s, morph-v3-fast at 10,500+ tok/s, Compact at 33,000 tok/s, and Reflex classifiers at ~90ms per turn. The GitHub demos cite an older 4,500+ tok/s figure. These are headline numbers only, with no benchmark methodology, hardware or concurrency conditions, latency percentiles, or load-testing guidance to substantiate them. Missing for 10: published benchmark methodology or reproducible results, latency distributions (TTFT/p50/p99), load-testing guides, independent corroboration of the throughput figures.
